svg.aria-label: What a reviewer needs for a review to be a control. Four conditions mean reviewers can overrule the system: the decision, one question written down; the evidence, in view beside the output; the time, a cap per shift; and the authority to say no at no cost. The fifth, the test, planted errors that get caught, shows that they sometimes do. Without each one: the reviewer checks how it reads, an error that looks right goes out, rare errors slip by late in a session, yes becomes the quick answer, and a check and a stamp look the same.
